purpose: Own the read-only boundary between Auggie command discovery and any future AgentSwitchboard ACP/GNHF integration.
readinessRequires: auggie --version exits zero within the bounded timeout
auggie --help exits zero within the bounded timeout
forbiddenActions: run Auggie login or token commands
start the ACP server during readiness classification
claim authentication or ACP handshake from help output
proofCeiling: CLI readiness and advertised capability discovery only; authentication, ACP handshake, model/provider readiness, repository mutation, terminal presentation, and unattended GNHF execution require separate live proof.
